title: GeneratorSpecComplianceAnalyzer
description: Comprehensive generator specification extraction translated from the Content Understanding analyzer definition. Extract normalized facts and preserve exact source evidence; external YAML rules determine compliance.

document_metadata.description: Identifying information for the submittal being graded.

vendor_name.description: Manufacturer or supplier submitting the generator set.

generator_model.description: Generator set model or part number.

rated_output.description: Rated electrical output including units and rating class, for example '2500 kW standby' or '2000 kVA prime'.

document_date.description: Publication or revision date of the document.

product_line.description: Which product line the submittal targets. Determines which fuel tank sizing rule applies: Retail requires at least 30 hours runtime at 100% load using 80% of rated tank capacity; xScale requires at least 48 hours at 100% load using 100% of rated tank capacity.

source_text.description: Verbatim engine type description as stated in the document, including stroke cycle and cooling medium.

is_four_stroke.description: True if the engine is explicitly described as four-stroke or four-cycle.

is_water_cooled.description: True if the engine is explicitly described as water-cooled or liquid-cooled.

source_text.description: Verbatim text describing air induction or turbocharging arrangement.

is_turbocharged.description: True if the engine is explicitly described as turbocharged.

aftercooled.description: Baseline: engine must be aftercooled (charge air cooled).

source_text.description: Verbatim text describing aftercooling, intercooling, or charge air cooling.

is_aftercooled.description: True if the engine is explicitly described as aftercooled, intercooled, or charge-air cooled.

fuel_consumption.description: Baseline: fuel consumption values must be provided at 50%, 75% and 100% load, with fan, in both metric and imperial units.

source_text.description: Verbatim fuel consumption statement, including the load points, fan condition, and units as printed in the document.

load_points.description: One entry for each published fuel consumption load point.

load_percent.description: Percent of rated load for this data point, for example 50, 75 or 100.

with_fan.description: True if the value is stated as 'with fan'. False if stated as 'without fan'.

consumption_liters_per_hour.description: Metric fuel consumption in litres per hour, if stated.

consumption_gallons_per_hour.description: Imperial fuel consumption in US gallons per hour, if stated.

metric_units_provided.description: True if fuel consumption is reported in metric units anywhere in the document.

imperial_units_provided.description: True if fuel consumption is reported in imperial units anywhere in the document.

exhaust_emissions.description: Baseline: comply with national and local requirements; EPA Tier 2 is the stated minimum; NOx+HC, CO and PM must be reported.

source_text.description: Verbatim emissions certification and compliance statement.

national_local_compliance_stated.description: True if the document claims compliance with the national and local emissions requirements applicable at the installation site.

emissions_tier.description: Certified emissions tier or stage as stated, for example 'EPA Tier 2', 'EPA Tier 4 Final', 'EU Stage V'.

nox_plus_hc.description: Reported NOx+HC value including units, typically g/kWh or g/hp-hr.

cooling_requirements.description: Baseline: closed-loop liquid cooling; full-load capability at site conditions; 50/50 glycol-water mixture; maximum external radiator pressure drop 0.5 inches water gauge.

source_text.description: Verbatim cooling system description.

closed_loop_liquid_cooling.description: True if the cooling system is explicitly described as closed-loop liquid cooling.

coolant_mixture.description: Stated coolant mixture, for example '50/50 ethylene glycol and water'.

max_external_radiator_pressure_drop_in_w.description: Maximum external static pressure or restriction the radiator can tolerate, expressed in inches of water gauge. Convert to inches water gauge if stated in Pa or mm H2O.

full_load_at_site_conditions.description: True if the document states the cooling system supports full rated load at the specified site ambient conditions.

starting_system.description: Baseline: 24 VDC negative ground; minimum two non-redundant starting motors; three 10-second crank cycles; start and accept load within 10 seconds.

source_text.description: Verbatim starting system description.

system_voltage_vdc.description: Starting system nominal DC voltage, for example 24.

negative_ground.description: True if the starting system is stated as negative ground.

number_of_starting_motors.description: Quantity of starting motors or starter assemblies provided.

starting_motors_non_redundant.description: True if the starting motors are non-redundant, meaning all motors are required to crank the engine rather than one being a standby spare.

crank_cycle_seconds.description: Duration in seconds of each crank cycle.

number_of_crank_cycles.description: Number of crank attempts before lockout.

start_and_load_acceptance_seconds.description: Time in seconds from start signal to the set accepting load.

lubrication_system.description: Baseline: gear-type positive-displacement full-pressure oil pump; water-cooled oil cooler; greater than 90% removal of particles 5 micrometres and smaller; full-flow fail-safe filtration.

source_text.description: Verbatim lubrication system description.

oil_pump_type.description: Oil pump type as stated, for example 'gear-type positive displacement'.

full_pressure_lubrication.description: True if the lubrication system is described as full-pressure.

oil_cooler_type.description: Oil cooler type as stated, for example 'water-cooled' or 'air-cooled'.

particle_size_microns.description: Particle size in micrometres that the stated efficiency applies to.

full_flow_fail_safe_filtration.description: True if filtration is described as full-flow with a fail-safe or bypass provision.

base_tank_design.description: Baseline: rectangular, generator-approved construction; reinforced support rated 5,000 lb per generator mounting-hole location; comply with local requirements and applicable tank standards.

source_text.description: Verbatim base fuel tank construction description.

tank_shape.description: Tank geometry as stated, for example 'rectangular' or 'cylindrical'.

generator_approved_construction.description: True if the tank is stated to be of construction approved by the generator set manufacturer.

local_requirements_compliance.description: True if the document claims the tank complies with local code requirements at the installation site.

support_rating_lb_per_mounting_hole.description: Reinforced support load rating in pounds at each generator mounting-hole location.

tank_standards.description: Tank construction standards or listings cited, for example 'UL 142', 'UL 2085'.

tank_sizing.description: Baseline: Retail requires at least 30 hours at 100% load using 80% of rated capacity. xScale requires at least 48 hours at 100% load using 100% of rated capacity. Normal filling is limited to 90% of tank volume in both cases.

source_text.description: Verbatim tank sizing and runtime statement.

rated_tank_capacity.description: Rated fuel tank capacity including units, for example '4000 gal' or '15000 L'.

stated_runtime_hours.description: Stated runtime in hours at 100% load.

usable_capacity_percent.description: Percent of rated capacity assumed usable in the runtime calculation.

normal_fill_limit_percent.description: Percent of tank volume the normal fill is limited to.

fuel_monitoring.description: Baseline: direct-reading gauge plus digital fuel-level and leak monitoring; Modbus or TCP/IP, converted to TCP/IP for the monitoring interface.

source_text.description: Verbatim fuel monitoring description.

communication_protocols.description: Monitoring communication protocols offered, for example 'Modbus RTU', 'Modbus TCP', 'TCP/IP', 'BACnet'.

direct_reading_gauge_provided.description: True if a direct-reading mechanical gauge is included.

digital_fuel_level_monitoring.description: True if digital or electronic fuel-level monitoring is provided in addition to the direct-reading gauge.

digital_leak_monitoring.description: True if digital or electronic leak monitoring is provided.

converted_to_tcp_ip.description: True if the monitoring output is delivered as TCP/IP to the monitoring interface, either natively or through a Modbus-to-TCP/IP converter or gateway.

leak_detection.description: Baseline: containment-basin leak detector and water-detection probe, both monitored at the engine controller.

source_text.description: Verbatim leak and water detection description.

containment_basin_leak_detector_provided.description: True if a leak detector is provided in the containment basin, rupture basin, or secondary containment.

water_detection_probe_provided.description: True if a water-detection probe is provided to sense water intrusion in the fuel tank or basin.

monitored_at_engine_controller.description: True if the leak and water detection alarms are annunciated at the engine controller.

fuel_level_monitoring.description: Baseline: direct gauge; low alarm at 50%; high alarm at 90%; high-high alarm at 95%; level transmitter; spare fitting.

source_text.description: Verbatim fuel level monitoring and alarm setpoint description.

low_alarm_percent.description: Low fuel level alarm setpoint as a percent of tank volume.

high_alarm_percent.description: High fuel level alarm setpoint as a percent of tank volume.

high_high_alarm_percent.description: High-high fuel level alarm setpoint as a percent of tank volume.

level_transmitter_provided.description: True if a continuous level transmitter is included.

spare_fitting_provided.description: True if a spare or future-use tank fitting is included.

filtration.description: Baseline: on-board secondary filter at 2 micrometres; two parallel primary filtration systems at 20 micrometres each; maximum pressure drop 2.5 psi; water separation; isolation valves permitting online servicing.

source_text.description: Verbatim fuel filtration description.

secondary_filter_microns.description: On-board secondary fuel filter rating in micrometres.

primary_filter_microns.description: Primary fuel filter rating in micrometres.

number_of_parallel_primary_filters.description: Quantity of parallel primary filtration systems.

max_pressure_drop_psi.description: Maximum allowable pressure drop across the primary filtration system in psi.

water_separation_provided.description: True if water separation is included in the fuel filtration system.

online_serviceable_isolation.description: True if isolation valves allow one filter train to be serviced while the engine runs.

fuel_return_cooling.description: Baseline: a fuel return cooler must be evaluated and installed when needed so that returning fuel does not affect engine operation or the generator rating.

source_text.description: Verbatim fuel return cooling description.

return_cooler_provided.description: True if a fuel return cooler is supplied or explicitly evaluated as unnecessary.

overfill_protection.description: Baseline: remote fill connections with automatic overfill protection; overfill-prevention valve set at 95%.

source_text.description: Verbatim overfill protection description.

remote_fill_connections_provided.description: True if remote fill connections are provided.

automatic_overfill_protection.description: True if the overfill protection operates automatically without operator intervention.

overfill_valve_setpoint_percent.description: Overfill-prevention valve setpoint as a percent of tank volume.

maximum_ambient_temperature.description: Baseline: generator system rated to at least +40 degrees Celsius.

source_text.description: Verbatim maximum ambient temperature rating for the generator system.

stated_max_c.description: Maximum ambient temperature in degrees Celsius. Convert from Fahrenheit if needed.

minimum_ambient_temperature.description: Baseline: generator system rated to at least -35 degrees Celsius.

source_text.description: Verbatim minimum ambient temperature rating for the generator system. If no explicit system-level minimum ambient rating is given, fall back to the coldest cold-weather capability the document commits to anywhere, such as a coolant or antifreeze protection temperature, a cold-start rating, or a jacket water heater rating, and quote that sentence instead. Prefix such a fallback with 'Proxy: '.

stated_min_c.description: Minimum ambient temperature in degrees CELSIUS, negative for sub-zero. CRITICAL: if the document states the temperature in Fahrenheit, you MUST convert before emitting this number. celsius = (fahrenheit - 32) * 5 / 9. For example 'minus 10 degrees F' MUST be emitted as -23.3, never as -10. Never copy a Fahrenheit value into this field unchanged.

is_proxy_value.description: True when StatedValue came from a coolant protection, cold-start, or heater rating rather than an explicit generator system minimum ambient temperature rating.

relative_humidity.description: Baseline: generator system rated for 0% to 95% relative humidity.

source_text.description: Verbatim relative humidity rating for the generator system.

stated_min_rh_percent.description: Lower bound of the rated relative humidity range, as a percent.

stated_max_rh_percent.description: Upper bound of the rated relative humidity range, as a percent.

altitude.description: Baseline: minimum standard capability of 1,000 metres above sea level without derate. A project RFQ may specify a higher altitude.

source_text.description: Verbatim altitude capability or derate statement.

stated_altitude_meters.description: Altitude in METRES above sea level at which full rating is maintained. CRITICAL: if the document states the altitude in feet, you MUST convert to metres before emitting this number. metres = feet * 0.3048. For example '1000 feet' MUST be emitted as 305, never as 1000. Never copy a value expressed in feet into this field unchanged.

derate_above_stated_altitude.description: Stated derate rate above the full-rating altitude, if given.

generator_control_ambient_rating.description: Baseline: -40 C to +70 C; 95% RH non-condensing from 30 C to 60 C.

source_text.description: Verbatim generator control ambient temperature and humidity rating.

stated_min_c.description: Lower bound of the generator control operating temperature range in degrees Celsius.

stated_max_c.description: Upper bound of the generator control operating temperature range in degrees Celsius.

stated_humidity_rating.description: Humidity rating for the generator control, including condensing qualifier and applicable temperature band.

battery_charger_ambient_rating.description: Baseline: -20 C to +60 C; 5% to 95% RH non-condensing.

source_text.description: Verbatim battery charger ambient temperature and humidity rating.

stated_min_c.description: Lower bound of the battery charger operating temperature range in degrees Celsius.

stated_max_c.description: Upper bound of the battery charger operating temperature range in degrees Celsius.

stated_humidity_rating.description: Humidity rating for the battery charger, including condensing qualifier.

source_text.description: Verbatim voltage regulator ambient temperature rating.

stated_min_c.description: Lower bound of the voltage regulator operating temperature range in degrees Celsius.

stated_max_c.description: Upper bound of the voltage regulator operating temperature range in degrees Celsius.

engine_governing_control_ambient_rating.description: Baseline: -40 C to +85 C; 0% to 90% RH.

source_text.description: Verbatim engine governing control ambient temperature and humidity rating.

stated_min_c.description: Lower bound of the engine governing control operating temperature range in degrees Celsius.

stated_max_c.description: Upper bound of the engine governing control operating temperature range in degrees Celsius.

stated_humidity_rating.description: Humidity rating for the engine governing control.
